out.summary: KEI Industries is a wires and cables maker (with small EPC and stainless steel wire businesses) that reported Q2 FY27 net sales of INR 3,776 crores, up 38.5%, with EBITDA margin near 11% and PAT of INR 262 crores. It is debt-free with a strong order book and is ramping up its Sanand plant, guiding to 25%-plus growth this year and 20% CAGR over 3-4 years.
out.how_it_makes_money: Sales mix: 59% B2C via dealers/distributors, 26% domestic institutional (B2B), 13% exports, 2% domestic EPC and stainless steel wire; EPC is being wound down.

bull.point: Strong domestic growth with dealer-led retail mix rising
bull.quote: our overall retail dealer distributor sale in last 5 years has grown from 40% contribution to now 59% contribution

bull.point: Strong export order book, half from the US
bull.quote: the export order, which is INR 991 crores, it is from the Middle East, from Australia, from America. America order is almost 50%

bull.point: Sanand Phase 2 to add large EHV capacity
bull.quote: new capacity additional will be more than INR 1,500 crores to INR 1,700 crores in terms of value

bear.point: Gross margin declined ~180bps YoY; management attributed partly to EPC losses and inventory valuation
bear.quote: EPC losses, if I take that even as a percentage of gross profit, that explains 80 basis point decline, leaving another 100 basis points

bear.point: Sanand ramp-up is slow, dragging inventory and working capital
bear.quote: Sanand capacity addition is taking time to ramp up and in coming months, capacity utilization will increase month after month

bear.point: EPC segment continues to post small losses while winding down
bear.quote: in next 1 or 2 quarters, the INR 5 crores to INR 7 crores loss will be there because we are almost closing down the EPC

watch.point: Whether Sanand Phase 2 commercial production starts on time and ramps up
watch.quote: The planned commercial production of Phase 2 of extra high-voltage cable and HT cable in Sanand will commence by end of March '27

watch.point: Whether inventory normalizes and working capital days fall as promised
watch.quote: it is by the end of the year, it will get normalized to the earlier level. The holding level will remain same by the March '27
